probes.question: In which city did the dancing plague of 1518 begin?
True or false: it is known why the victims of the 1518 dancing plague danced.

image.alt: Engraving by Hendrik Hondius after Brueghel of afflicted people in the dancing mania, clutching and supporting one another on a country path.

panels.text: Strasbourg, July 1518. A woman known as Frau Troffea begins to dance fervently and uncontrollably in a street.
Others join. Somewhere between 50 and 400 people take to dancing for weeks.
Historical documents, including physician notes, cathedral sermons and notes issued by the city council, are clear that the victims danced. It is not known why.
The Dancing Plague ultimately ceased in September, when the remaining dancers were led to a mountaintop chapel to pray for absolution.
